properties.rationale: Deferred on Anthony's word, 2026-07-28 — but flagged as the item most deserving to be UNparked first, because it contradicts a founding requirement (req:intent-preserved, the past is never overwritten) and does so SILENTLY: record_change reported success both times and the design's own history lost a version with no warning. Deferred rather than patched because the fix is a genuine three-way choice, not an oversight: snapshot identity per REVISION (include the ChangeEvent id — truest to the founding rule, but HAS_SNAPSHOT becomes one-to-many and "the snapshot for this epoch" stops being a single thing readers can assume); REFUSE a second record_change in one epoch (cheap and loud, but epochs bound a round of WORK not a single edit, so it pushes an unrelated concern onto the caller); or keep one snapshot per epoch DELIBERATELY as the state at epoch start, making the second call a no-op (preserves the original, loses the intermediate, and needs semantics written down that are currently only implied). Each changes what a reader may assume, so it is a vocabulary-shaped call. What is NOT open: the silence. If a revision cannot be snapshotted without discarding an earlier one, the call must say so — that part needs no decision.
